scope: formal_training_readiness_only; no G1 experiment is registered as executed

common.aggregation: sum sufficient statistics first; derive scalars once

metrics.name: point_global_relative_rmse_pct
metrics.aggregation: global point sum over the evaluation population

metrics.name: sample_first_relative_rmse_pct
metrics.aggregation: arithmetic mean of per-sample control-volume relative RMSE
metrics.weight: control_volume_m3 within sample; equal sample weight across samples

level_b_high_resolution.resolution_role: output query and reconstructed full-field resolution
level_b_high_resolution.additional_boundary: reconstruction is included in prediction generation, never in metric definition
level_b_high_resolution.fvm_role: reference solver only; no surrogate error is assigned to FVM

split_roles.train: training labels allowed only for registered training runs
split_roles.valid_iid: held-out validation set; allowed for checkpoint qualification and frozen replication
split_roles.test_iid: sealed from this readiness task; no access

checkpoint_selection_rule.historical_reference: frozen V6/P1i route registry and valid_iid selection metric

readiness_optimization_equivalence.numeric_policy: narrow CPU float32 compiler-roundoff envelope; not a scientific tolerance and not a publication claim
readiness_optimization_equivalence.rationale: eager and compiled CPU lowerings may reassociate float32 reductions by a few ULPs

frozen_artifact_policy: v6_frozen_artifact_denylist.json is authoritative; no overwrite, rename, regeneration, or in-place metadata update
